title: Warm Semolina Pudding with Jammy French Fruits
description: A warm, comforting semolina pudding topped with sweet jammy French fruits, perfect for a cozy dessert.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine semolina, milk, and sugar. Whisk until the sugar dissolves.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in the egg until well combined.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the puddings are set.
Meanwhile, warm the French jam in a saucepan over low heat.
To serve, place a warm pudding on each plate and top with a spoonful of warm jam and a few fresh fruits.
Note: You can also top with whipped cream or a dollop of mascarpone cheese if desired.
